label: the yard crew
note: Issue #611: the first race crew, three locals who race out of Dorrin's yard on the Hoodoo Run (content/core/racing/courses/hoodoo_run.json). Read by src/systems/racing/race_crew.gd (RaceCrew); a new crew is one more file like this one. `hangout`: the landmark they hang out by and, in its frame (x toward the town, as the landmark's location file), where each one stands (`stand`) and where their speeder is parked (`park`, built once you come near and kept; they walk to it when you accept a race, cruise to the grid, and park it there again after). `profile`: their soldier profile. `racers`: the leader first (talk to them for the race menu), each with a look (CharacterKit pieces), a speeder paint and parts (content/core/vehicles/speeder_upgrades.json) and a driving skill (content/core/vehicles/speeder_drivers.json). `rules`: the least buy-in, the buy-in steps, the winner's multiple of the buy-in, the lap they start shooting from, how far off the racing line puts you out (m), and the crowd's size. `shop` (optional): a speeder mechanic's stall by the hangout, Dorrin's shop kept by one of his cousins: `id` the shop in content/core/vehicles/speeder_upgrades.json 'shops', `at` [x, z] in the hangout's frame and `yaw_deg` (the layout: content/core/locations/speeder_stall.json; the yard crew have none, Dorrin's counter is right there). `rung` and `after` (issue #615): their place on the ladder and the crew you must beat before they race you (empty for the first). `lines`: what they say (issue #617: pink_slips, slips_accept, no_room, slips_won, slips_lost, slips_not_yours are the pink-slip race; {ride} is a speeder's paint and parts) ({name} is the leader's name, {crew} this crew, {stake} the buy-in, {pot} the winnings). Speeder classes: a racer's `model` is its vehicle file (speeder, racer, hauler; none = the Sand-boxer). The ladder: the yard crew ride stock Sand-boxers with a first-tier part at most and lasers only; the basin crew bring a fast box truck, more tuned Sand-boxers, seekers and mines; the salt crew field a lightly tuned racer beside a fully stacked Sand-boxer and box truck, with every piece of race gear.

lines.slips_accept: Pink slips? Ha. Winner drives home in both.
lines.no_room: Where would you even park it? Your row's full.
lines.slips_not_yours: Bet a ride that isn't yours yet? Shake whoever owns it first, then we talk slips.
lines.slips_won: {ride} is yours. It's waiting outside the back gate.
lines.slips_lost: They drive off in your speeder. Win it back: race them for pink slips again.
challenge: That thing yours? Cute. Think it can keep up with us round the rocks?
Two laps round the Hoodoo Run. Put your money down or get out of the way.
lines.menu_body: {course}: {laps} laps through the gates. {rule} Winner takes {multiple} times the buy-in. Your best lap here: {best}.
lines.rule_shoot: From lap {lap} it gets rough: we shoot.
lines.too_poor: {stake} credits, minimum. Come back when you've got it.
lines.no_speeder: Race us on what, your feet? Bring a speeder.
lines.accept: Done. Get to the line. Don't keep the crowd waiting.
lines.comms: We'll be on your comms the whole way round. You'll hear us laughing.
lines.go_line: Get to the start line by the antennas
taunts: Nice paint. Shame about the engine.
jeers: Still in front? Not for long!
lines.leader_lost: Lucky run. We'll have you next time.
lines.leader_won: Told you. Better luck next time.
lines.next_crew: You want a real race? The basin crew took over the old outpost south of the port, right in the middle of their course. Tell them we sent you.
